name: Backblaze B2, pay as you go

storage.note: Billed per byte-hour at $6.95 per TB per 30 days; the first 10 GB of an account are free.

egress.note: Free up to 3 times the account's average stored data in the month, then $0.01 per GB.

transactions.note: Class A, B and C API calls (every call sotyware makes) are free for pay-as-you-go accounts; class D (event notifications) costs $0.004 per 10,000 after the first 2,500 a day.

notes: Every B2 bucket keeps old versions: hidden files and older versions are stored data until a lifecycle rule removes them.
Unfinished large-file uploads keep their parts stored until they are cancelled.
Committed contracts (B2 Reserve, Overdrive) are priced differently.
